about: Plan 224 D13: the consent line a guest reads before Ask to join, from the show's saved platforms. The web's guest page (videorc-web lib/cloud/guest-consent.ts consentLine) and the desktop's Guests tab (apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/lib/guests-view.ts guestConsentLine) both reproduce every case word for word; videorc-web keeps a byte-identical copy at tests/fixtures/guest-consent-lines.json.
